name: Happy Go Lucky - Yellow Rose
description: Classic fragrant, soft blush-pink blooms on sturdy climbing canes. A grandiflora with the old-fashioned good looks of an English garden rose but the excellent disease resistance and minimal upkeep requirements of a top-quality modern hybrid. Each fully double, pure yellow bloom produced by this bushy, vigorous variety measures an enormous 6 in diameter and has a fruity fragrance about it. Plants have large, glossy, medium green leaves and grow 3–5' tall. You can count on Happy Go Lucky to bloom continually from late spring until the first frost of autumn. Great for use in beds and borders, and a wonderful cut flower.
Symbolism & Meanings: Yellow roses are often associated with friendship, warmth, and joy.

marketReference.text: You wont find roses like this in stores like HomeDepot. A similar climbing rose in a 6-inch pot is listed for around $80. Prices and availability may change.

Care: Full sun, deep watering 1-2 times weekly, rich composted organic soil

name: Pink Ceceille Brunner Rose Vine
description: Classic fragrant, soft blush-pink blooms on sturdy climbing canes.
Symbolism & Meanings: Represents purity, innocence, remembrance, and sympathy.
What you get for your money: A healthy potted 25 gallon plant. The pot is about 35 inches across. It has been thoughtfully trimmed and mulched to help develop a healthy root system for the upcoming season. That is why it does not have flowers today.

marketReference.text: A similar climbing rose in a 6-inch pot is listed for around $80. Prices and availability may change.

Care: Full sun, deep watering 1-2 times weekly, rich composted soil. Keep on clipping flowers to produce more and more blooms during blooming season. If you prune all the excess growth and keep only the main canes in winter, the vine will profusley bloom next season. Thats a gift that will never stop giving
